sequenceOfOperation.note: Generic packaged-RTU cooling sequence. Replace with the M2 sequence from the manual.
value: Thermostat/BAS closes G: M2 energizes the blower contactor (or VFD run), blower starts.
Y1 call: if outdoor conditions allow, economizer modulates to hold mixed/discharge air setpoint (free cooling) before any compressor runs.
If free cooling can't satisfy or is locked out: M2 checks safeties (HPS, LPS, freezestat) and minimum-off timers, then energizes compressor 1 contactor.
Condenser fans cycle on head pressure or with the compressor contactor.
Y2 call: next compressor stage after the inter-stage delay.
A safety opening drops the compressor; repeated trips within the M2's count window lock the stage out and post an alarm.

cooling-95F.note: Normal-operation readings are representative values for a healthy R-410A RTU at 95°F OA / 75°F RA, not manufacturer charging-chart values.

readings.txt_tstat: BAS shows occupied, G on, Y1 and Y2 called. Space 76°F, setpoint 72°F.
readings.txt_controller: No active alarms. Compressor 1 and 2 outputs on, blower on.
readings.txt_look_unit: Unit running. Compressors humming steady, condenser fans spinning, blower running. No odd noises.
readings.txt_look_condenser: Condenser coil reasonably clean. All fans turning, warm air off the top.
readings.txt_look_evap: Filters moderately loaded. Coil clean and sweating evenly. Belt tension good.
readings.txt_look_electrical: Panel clean. No burn marks or discolored wire. Contactors look fine.
readings.txt_look_economizer: Damper at about 20% open. Linkage tight, coupling secure. Mixed air sensor mounted downstream of the dampers, ahead of the filters.
readings.txt_manual_stroke: Damper strokes freely through full travel by hand.
readings.txt_jade_checkout: DAMPER OPEN: actuator drives full open, blades follow. DAMPER CLOSE: drives closed, blades seal.
